title: HalluciGuard-eye: knowledge graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation for hallucination detection and mitigation in ophthalmic multimodal large language models.
summary: HalluciGuard-Eye combines knowledge-graph retrieval and hierarchical factuality scoring; across four ophthalmic imaging benchmarks it reports 42.2% lower hallucination rates and 91.6% factual accuracy on EyePACS, while diabetic-retinopathy sensitivity/specificity reached 89.6%/92.1%. This is a benchmark result, not clinical deployment evidence.
